blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Monday, announced road closures and several traffic schemes from Nov. 15 to 18 as the country hosts the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nation (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. The MMDA advised that roads surrounding the Philippine International Convention Center and Cultural Center of the Philippines Complex would be closed over the said period: A list of alternative routes have been released, as well, for individuals traveling from Roxas Boulevard toward Diokno Blvd. and Macapagal Blvd. and vice versa.
